callees.name: re.escape
callees.post_condition: Returns a string in which all non-alphanumeric characters of pattern are escaped with backslashes, such that the result can safely be used as a literal pattern in a regular expression.

callees.name: re.search
callees.signature: re.search(pattern: str, string: str) -> Match | None
callees.pre_condition: pattern is a valid regular expression string. string is the text to search.
callees.post_condition: Returns a Match object when pattern matches a substring in string, or None when no match is found. A Match object is truthy and None is falsy in boolean context.
